title: Declan fixture household income violates the fixtures module's own stated invariant (350k primary + 0 co-applicants != 650k household)
detail: 350,000 + 0 co-applicants + (empty income_sources in the matching pdf_prebake snapshot) = 350,000, not 650,000. Guarantor income (310k) is not household. The leaderboard shows a household figure that does not add up, contradicting the module's documented invariant.
recommended_fix: Either set Declan's household_monthly_income_cents to 350000, or add a matching income source / co-applicant in both the client fixture and the prebake snapshot so the sum is 650,000.

title: Aoife's employer_ref_email differs between client fixture and pdf_prebake row, violating the module's own 'mirror BOTH sides' rule
detail: The baked PDF shows roberts@finlaydigital.example.com while the applicant detail page shows rachel.obrien@finlaydigital.example.com for the same referee — an internal contradiction in the demo's flagship applicant.
recommended_fix: Change row_aoife's employer_ref_email to rachel.obrien@finlaydigital.example.com to match the client fixture, then re-run the prebake.

title: pdf_prebake header documents a positional priv-dir argument that main() never reads (it uses RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR instead)
detail: The module header and main() document two different interfaces. The documented `-- server/priv` argument is silently ignored; only the env var (default "priv") takes effect.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the header regen instructions to the env-var form actually implemented (RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR=... gleam run -m demo/pdf_prebake) and remove the phantom positional argument.

evidence:

title: Design mock stat cards are arithmetically inconsistent and conflict with the conformance test's pinned stats (7 scored + 1 pending != 9 total)
evidence:

" ... "

" — while fixtures_conformance_test.gleam pins " stats.total_applications |> should.equal(9) stats.pending_analysis |> should.equal(1) stats.scored_applications |> should.equal(8)"
detail: 7 scored + 1 pending = 8, not 9 — the approved mock's own arithmetic is off by one, and it disagrees with the shipped fixtures (8 scored). The Maples card in the same mock also says "8 of 8 analysed" while its own bar shows "2 pending".
recommended_fix: Correct the mock stat card to 8 scored (or note one unscored applicant), aligning with demo_fixtures.gleam and the conformance test.

title: lint_demo_network.py's 35-line upward window accepts a demo_mode guard from an unrelated neighbouring arm, despite claiming the call must be in the False branch of the same guard
evidence:
# Check a generous window above the call for a demo_mode guard in the
        # same scope (the False branch of a demo case can sit 10+ lines below
        # the guard when the True branch is verbose).
        window = "\n".join(lines[max(0, idx - 35) : idx])
        guarded = "model.demo_mode" in window or "updated_model.demo_mode" in window
detail: The check does not verify the call is in the guard's False branch or even the same arm: any `model.demo_mode` string within 35 lines above — including a guard in a different arm or the True branch itself — satisfies it. The field-notes claim the lint was bite-tested so 'guard in unrelated arm must NOT satisfy'; this implementation cannot uphold that.
recommended_fix: Confine the window to the enclosing arm's line range (stop at the arm boundary found by the scope walk) and exclude lines belonging to the True branch, or parse the case structure rather than scanning raw text.

title: Baked PDF positive for Aoife states household income 'covers 2.0x the rent' — actual ratio is ~2.96x (the 2.0x figure matches primary income only)
evidence: positives: "[{\"label\":\"Household income covers 2.0x the rent with a clear surplus\",\"category\":\"income_affordability\"}, ..." combined with "      monthly_rent_cents: 245_000," and row_aoife's household of 725_000 ("485_000,\n      725_000,")
detail: €7,250 household / €2,450 rent = 2.96x; 2.0x matches the €4,850 primary income. The label as written ('Household income covers 2.0x') is factually wrong in a public marketing PDF, while neighbouring flags (Sara 72%, Liam >50%) are computed correctly.
recommended_fix: Reword to 'Household income covers nearly 3x the rent' or change the subject to the primary income so the number matches the fixture data, then re-bake.

title: lint_demo_network.py carries a stale duplicated comment block above DEMO_INTERCEPTED and a mis-pasted 'helpers' comment inside EXEMPT_ARMS
evidence:
# Message arms whose real api calls are structurally unreachable in demo mode
# (auth flows always exit the demo first; ApiReturnedSession is guarded at the
# top of the handler).
# Messages whose real arms in update_inner are unreachable in demo mode
# because demo/demo_update.gleam intercepts them and resolves from the
# in-memory store. Keep this in sync with the request messages in
# demo_update.handle — a message listed here must have a demo arm there.
DEMO_INTERCEPTED = { ... and later: EXEMPT_ARMS = {
    # helpers that branch on demo_mode internally
    # auth_api arms — demo mode is always False here
detail: Two overlapping header comments sit above DEMO_INTERCEPTED (the first describes EXEMPT_ARMS content, not the intercepted set), and EXEMPT_ARMS opens with a comment about helpers although helpers live in DEMO_BRANCHED_HELPERS. Residue of an edit; confusing for the mandated manifest upkeep.
recommended_fix: Delete the orphaned first comment block above DEMO_INTERCEPTED and the '# helpers that branch on demo_mode internally' line inside EXEMPT_ARMS.
